activity.notes: Sheikh Zayed was elected the first President of the United Arab Emirates at federation on 2 December 1971 and remained president until his death on 2 November 2004.

sources.title: United Arab Emirates Annual Book — UAE Government
sources.citation_text: The UAE government's annual book states that Sheikh Zayed was elected the federation's first President on 2 December 1971 and died on 2 November 2004.
